te zullen vooropgaan
voorop te zullen gaan

glosses: To go before, go in front of.

examples.text: But harm precedes not sin: onely our Foe / Tempting affronts us with his foul esteem / Of our integritie
This is the custom of sending on a basket-woman, who is to precede the pomp at a coronation, and to strew the stage with flowers, before the great personages begin their procession.
An interesting feature in the weeks preceding the diversions was the provision of a road-learning train to familiarise main line drivers with the alternative route.

glosses: To cause to be preceded; to preface; to introduce.

examples.text: It has been usual to precede hostilities by a public declaration communicated to the enemy.

glosses: To have higher rank than (someone or something else).
Brief editorial preface (usually to an article or essay).
Ir delante o anteceder en tiempo, orden o lugar.
Tener una persona o una cosa preferencia, primacía o superioridad sobre otra.
